SELECT 
  fish_date_doy as doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as num_trips,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 2) as avg_yt_per_angler
FROM trips 
WHERE fish_date_season = 6
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY doy, cls
LIMIT 200

SELECT 
  index_id,
  avail_season,
  ROUND(AVG(value), 2) as avg_value
FROM climate 
WHERE avail_season IN (6, 7) AND index_id = 'oni'
GROUP BY index_id, avail_season
ORDER BY avail_season
